subject: Intro demo — Redwood inference walkthrough (possible CTO brief window)
snippet: Acme's CTO may be in transit for the scheduled slot; proposing a 10:30 shift and assigning engineering backup to cover tech deep-dive.
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acme.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Intro demo — Redwood inference walkthrough

Hi Diego,

Thanks for proposing May 10 at 10:00 AM PT for the intro demo. That time works for the product team. Our CTO, Adrian Nguyen, expressed interest in joining briefly to understand the roadmap and high-level architecture — he said he might hop on for the first 20–30 minutes if his calendar allows.

Can you send a short agenda and confirm whether a technical lead will be available in case the CTO needs to step off?

Also please include any pre-demo artifacts we should skim.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Park
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo — Redwood inference walkthrough

Hi Jamie — great, thanks for confirming.

Short answers:
- Agenda: 60-minute walkthrough (intro + product demo + Q&A). I attached a one-page agenda (redwood_demo_agenda_v1.pdf).
- Tech backup: Monica (copied) will cover the deep-dive and run the live demo if Adrian can only join briefly.

If Adrian plans to join only for a short window, would you prefer we: 1) shift the start to align with his availability, or 2) keep the current time and make sure Monica handles the end-to-end demo and loops Adrian in for the top-level discussion? Either works on our side.

Calendar invite will be sent once we lock the time.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
calendly.com/diego-redwood
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Prep plan — Acme demo + CTO potential brief window

Sergio / Monica,

FYI — Acme wants Adrian (CTO) to potentially join the demo on May 10. Theres a decent chance he will be in transit during the scheduled slot. Can we do the following:

Action items
- Monica: be prepared to lead the full demo solo and keep a condensed 20–25 minute CTO-focused section at the top (architecture, roadmap, integration points).
- Sergio: have the performance slide set handy (quantified latency/cost comparisons) and be on standby to jump in for Q&A.
- Monica/Sergio: record a 10-minute backup tech summary we can drop into the meeting if Adrian is late — a short clip we can play or send right after.

Ill coordinate time with Jamie if their CTO gives a hard arrival time. Attach the current slide deck to this thread (agenda in the external thread).

Thanks — Diego
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acme.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Adrian Nguyen <adrian.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T07:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo — Redwood inference walkthrough

Diego — quick update from my side. Adrian confirmed interest but his travel itinerary has him in the air and landing window overlaps the 10:00 AM start. He said he can realistically join starting ~10:30 AM PT.

Options from our side:
- Move the meeting to 10:30 start so Adrian can join for the first 25–30 minutes.
- Keep 10:00 AM and have Monica present the full demo; Adrian will dial in if he can (likely 10:30).

If you can move to 10:30, thatd be preferred. I attached Adrians itinerary for context (adrian_travel_itinerary.pdf).

Jamie
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acme.com>, Adrian Nguyen <adrian.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo — Redwood inference walkthrough

Thanks for the update, Jamie — and thanks Adrian for the heads up. 10:30 AM PT works for us.

Plan:
- Reschedule meeting to May 10, 10:30–11:10 AM PT (40 minutes).
  - First 30 min: high-level architecture + roadmap with Adrian and product stakeholders (Diego + Monica).
  - Last 10 min: targeted technical follow-ups led by Monica and Sergio (deep-dive material will be available).
- Monica will keep the demo tight for the CTO window; Sergio will be ready for latency/cost Q&A.
- We will record the session and share the short backup tech summary if Adrian cannot join the tail end.

Next steps:
- Jamie: please confirm and Ill update the invite and send the revised agenda (link to agenda doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=agenda123).
- Monica / Sergio: please confirm you can make the 10:30 slot and that the condensed CTO section is ready.

Attachments: redwood_demo_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda) — will send final deck by May 8.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
-- End of thread --
